description:
HushGram v0.0.7 targets Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 (com.instagram.android) with 78 patches, 3 more than the last release. The new ones are Emoji style, Hide the Threads button and See who a story mentions, and the other builds of 450.0.0.50.77 patch now too.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. A re-signed Instagram can't pass Google's Play Store check whatever the patches do. Sign in with a spare account if you can, and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 2869 runtime tests passed locally. All 1182 patch tests passed too. All 78 patches applied to Instagram 450.0.0.50.77 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Build 385611438, the arm64-v8a (480-640dpi) bundle, is the one Manager names. The other arm64 builds of 450.0.0.50.77 and the x86 and x86_64 ones patch too, though Manager shows them as unsupported. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Keep the manager's signing key for updates, so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
